prompt: Which EU member states still haven't transposed NIS2 as of September 2026? We have subsidiaries in Ireland, Spain and France.
assertions: Identifies Ireland, Spain and France as the member states still lacking in-force transposition laws as of early September 2026
Cites the July 9, 2026 Commission referral to the CJEU for failure to notify transposition — which originally also included the Netherlands
Notes the Commission requested financial penalties: a lump sum plus daily penalty payments
Notes the Netherlands has since transposed (Cbw in force August 15, 2026) and should no longer be listed as a laggard
Gives the right advice: prepare subsidiaries against the directive text now — authorities have applied short compliance windows once national law lands
